observations: A solid black rounded form dominates the right-center, with a long curved line rising and hooking at the top against a flat sky-blue ground.
A smaller black head shape sits lower-left, containing two yellow rectangular marks and a yellow stitched-line mouth; short zigzag lines radiate outward around both forms.
A thick black diagonal fills the lower edge as a ground plane; a blue curved gap between the two black forms creates a negative-space arc.
reading: Two black masses—one large and round, one smaller with yellow-marked eyes and a sewn-looking mouth—sit against an unbroken blue field. Short zigzag lines scatter around both forms. The yellow marks read as alert or unsettled rather than calm. The blue arc between the forms pulls the eye inward, giving the image an odd stillness beneath its surface agitation.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #132 and nnxyz nnotb #134. Where #132 spreads many small black figures across white, #133 reduces to two forms on a single flat color, concentrating black-on-field contrast into a tighter space.

connections.reason: Both use solid black figures against a plain ground, but #132 scatters many small forms across white while #133 consolidates into two large masses on blue, making the contrast in density visible across title neighbors.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the blue gap between the two black forms begin and end, and how does that shape change the relationship between them?
ambiguities: rawblocks #43 shows a dense multi-color head on orange with no shared formal qualities to #133; excluded from connections.
Title order and recorded creation order align for this work in the owned subset, but gaps may exist elsewhere in the full nnotb catalogue.
